记录类 ArenaMatchSettings

java.lang.Object

top.brmc.bukkitplatform.towerwars.arena.ArenaMatchSettings
public record ArenaMatchSettings(int durationSeconds, int initialLives, long initialGold, long initialIncome, int incomeIntervalSeconds, int warmupSeconds, boolean scalingEnabled, List<ArenaScalingStage> scalingStages, boolean bountyEnabled, double bountyRatio, double bountyIncomeRatio, boolean bountyHologramEnabled, int bountyHologramDurationTicks) extends Record
可配置的对局参数: 初始生命、金币、收入、收入周期、准备时间、兽潮与击杀赏金。
